description: AI-powered commercial insurance submission triage covering risk appetite screening, exposure and loss history analysis, and technical pricing indication

agents.name: Appetite Screener
agents.description: Evaluates the submission against every rule in the insurer's written risk appetite ruleset, citing each finding by rule id, and identifies prohibited occupancy classes at both applicant and location level

agents.name: Exposure Analyst
agents.description: Aggregates total insured value across the property schedule, quantifies catastrophe zone concentration, and assesses prior claims for frequency, severity, trend and open reserves

agents.name: Pricing Indicator
agents.description: Anchors on the expiring programme rate and adjusts for loss experience, catastrophe exposure and data quality to produce a technical premium indication, plus the information required from the broker
